A17_C3.meaning: Root-selected A17 radial-derivative k-grid fidelity record, preserved exactly as JSON. Not the DDO C3R3 B2 state. Interpretation belongs to root/prereg; generic PASS values do not create agreement.

row_exact: speed_km_s finite real or null when invalid
NEWTONIAN.scope: A separately supplied source-produced baryonic model, before targets; no derivation from current UNT speeds and no observational baryon columns.

TSR_SUPPORT.mapping: Literal adopted bounds in kpc, including endpoint flags; each support includes its native radius. No inferred neighbour/midpoint/sample rule.
ring_exact: native_ring exact canonical JSON from failing_TRUNCATION_SHAPE_rings in same order

E1b.comparison: per-point model_exceeds_newtonian only on jointly valid INNER rows; null for invalid/unavailable, never target residual
E1b.status: AVAILABLE means supplied completed model and Newtonian pair is present, not scientific admission

P8_C3.original_k: same shared physical point/grid as supplied headline except entropy_K_factor1.0; own exact call/result custody
P8_C3.status: AVAILABLE means saved ORIGINAL_K plus externally registered C3 record pair is present

TSR.native_failing_rings: exact saved evidence retained even when flag mapping unavailable
TSR.rows: all43 query ids/radii; flags null when unavailable, boolean only with explicit support record
TSR.status: AVAILABLE only with matching adopted-support record; otherwise UNAVAILABLE

pin_shape.path: absolute path checked lexically and after symlink resolution
pin_shape.sha256: 64lowercasehex; bytes parsed from the same verified read

readout_availability: AVAILABLE only status COMPLETED and valid true and43 exact ordered rows; failures remain UNAVAILABLE with supplied rows and reasons retained. Explicit null INVALID rows retain their reason.

readout_binding.call_spec: pin of exact call spec; driver/result/call/finish joined from bytes
readout_binding.result: pin of native full driver result.json

inputs.a17_c3_record: explicit null or pin/binding as defined below
inputs.model_readout: explicit null or pin/binding as defined below
inputs.newtonian_reference: explicit null or pin/binding as defined below
inputs.ntest_compare: explicit null or pin/binding as defined below
inputs.original_k_readout: explicit null or pin/binding as defined below
inputs.tsr_support: explicit null or pin/binding as defined below

request_exact_fields.mode: SAVED_TARGET_FREE or SYNTHETIC; latter requires explicit flag
request_exact_fields.point_key: 64lowerhex external root context key, or null when no per-point records supplied

root_trust_boundary: Externally supplied request SHA and registered source-role contracts are the custody trust anchor. The extractor does not authenticate author identity, prove chronology, validate physical admission, select a C3 record for root, or certify producer science.
validation: Typed validation in selected extractor and64 synthetic tests; this is a protocol declaration, not a claim of an external JSON-schema validator run.
writes: Single exclusive new output after validation. Existing paths refuse. No subprocess, network, scientific module import or mutation of old evidence.
